locked_test.policy: score once only after validation criteria pass; freeze all checkpoints/configs before scoring; stream features once for all final models; no test tuning

loss.name: weighted_cross_entropy
loss.foreground_weights: train inverse sqrt predicate count, normalized by foreground median and clipped [0.25,4]

frequency_bias: fixed train-only log conditional foreground probabilities; global train fallback; smoothing 0.001
checkpoint_selection: best full-validation GC mR@50; report R@50, all epochs and convergence
screening_gate: confirmation runs only when geometry_feedback mR50 exceeds feature_membership and one_way with R50 drop <=1pp; otherwise stop and report insufficient evidence
claims: controlled reasoning evidence with this frontend and sampling; not published-detector reproduction or SOTA; no guaranteed positive result
